items.text: in a phone browser the cover no longer crowds its bottom row: install, share and index keep their own band, and on a short screen the title moves up instead of the founders call running into Share
on a phone, the messages at the top use the whole width from the duck-rabbit to the corner, so they rarely break onto two lines, and break evenly when they do
the duck-rabbit on the cover changes: while you play, Current keeps a piece of your look in one of the card colours, and the next time it opens the duck fills with it

once the field has played, the self-test never interrupts. A stall is logged and fixed quietly: Current gets the frames going again, or reloads straight back to the same look (no cover, controls still hidden if they were). The card only shows if Current can't start at all, or can't recover
no false alarm when you come back to Current from another app; a problem has to hold for a second look before it counts
the last problem's report is kept: open #selftest and tap copy last report, even after closing the card
no grey frame before the black opening: the page is black from its very first paint
the opening comes in order, in about three seconds: the duck-rabbit, then the namemark and CURRENT as the frost reveals the field, then the paths and founders call, then the bottom row

Current opens on black with the white duck-rabbit and stays black until everything has loaded and the field is drawing; then the duck glides into place and the black clears to the frosted cover over the moving field. No flash before the cover
when the self-test finds a problem, a glitching ASCII duck-rabbit congratulates you: you found a bad thing, help us fix it. The report button is right there
